title: Announcing PHPConf.Asia 2016. CFP Opens Now!
content:
Announcing - The Pan-Asian PHP Conference - CFP Opens NowPHPConf.Asia 2016

The second pan-Asian PHP conference will take place between 22 and 24 August 2016 in - the Garden City of the East! Monday, 22 August 2016 will be a day. Followed by 2 days of .ndthndSingaporeTutorialConference

Come and meet with the fastest growing PHP communities in Asia. More than 300 attendees are expected in this single track conference.
